svg.text: 10-bit asynchronous SAR ADC, sky130A, 1.8 V. CLK high = sample (bootstrapped top-plate sampling), CLK low = convert (self-timed).
Split-capacitor CDAC: every bit capacitor is two halves resting at VREFP / VREFN, so the common mode stays constant with no Vcm reference.
Bits 9..1 switch both sides (cells XDP/XDN 1..8), the last step switches one unit on the P side only. B9..B0 update at EOC rising.
SAR logic: one slice per bit, token T ripples left to right
